verdict.rationale: Lithic's Authorization Stream Access (ASA) sends each authorization as an HTTP POST, live from the ISO 8583 stream, to a developer endpoint. That endpoint answers with HTTP 200 and its approve/decline decision, which delivers the core real-time decisioning loop. The pack never states the response time budget or a timeout/stand-in fallback the developer can configure. Missing for 10: documented network time budget for the ASA response, documented timeout fallback behavior under developer control, independent or hands-on corroboration.
